messages.content: You are an evidence-focused reviewer of an authorized local hardware project. Provide concise final conclusions with source references, uncertainty and verification checks. You have no tools or file-write permissions. Do not claim to have run tests. Do not create or improve malicious behavior, concealment, evasion or attack-generation systems. No published challenge solutions.

Review an authorized clean hardware reverse-engineering analysis from original local files only. No published challenge solutions. Text-only review; you have no tools. Do not generate a Trojan, exfiltration, concealment, or attacks.

Original baseline has 32-bit MSB-first serial input/output, six functional inputs SCK/RST_N/MOSI/CS/START/ENC_DEC. 71 positive-edge registers include serial32, working32, four phase-counter bits, one ROM-output-valid bit, delayed BUSY and MISO. Four read-only byte ROMs contain the same effective nonlinear table. Direct physical bit ordering did not match AES, but independently traced input/output permutations normalize ALL 256 entries to the exact AES S-box (SHA256 c2d8e5eed6cbebd8625fc18f81486a7733c04f9b0129ffbe974c68b90308b4f2), computed from GF inverse and standard affine equation, not copied challenge code.

The Trojan project chat independently found: initial ROM address uses input byte with fixed inversions; feedback uses prior ROM result with the SAME inversions, no evolving key register. Forward path shifts four independent byte substitutions by one byte position. Inverse combinational path uses 32 working registers, separate from the ROMs. Mode selects final forward vs inverse result; both paths update concurrently. Two synchronized 2-bit counters go 00->01->10->11->00, giving four updates including START. Next edge loads serial output. A strict Python interpretation of original Boolean expressions and synchronous ROMs matches provided 59c359c3->9cd84392 and reverse. Independent Icarus comparison and exact per-byte inverse checks are still pending.

Give (1) precise high-level hypothesis justified by these facts, distinguishing AES S-box use from standard AES encryption; (2) what to prove to identify fixed key handling without overclaiming a secret key recovery or original author intent; (3) smallest strong independent checks for round direction, byte order, ROM timing and inverse path. Do not claim tests ran or guess key constants. Keep under 600 words.
